record.title: Banglabandha–Phulbari freight holiday and observed restoration, September–October 2022
record.direction: Both directions for the specified freight; see each phase for any narrower scope.
record.movement: Import/export freight including onward Nepal and Bhutan trade
record.exceptions: Traveller movement in both directions continued.
record.imposing_authority: Banglabandha and Phulbari trader associations; port officials report the arrangement
record.enforcement: Local traders arranged the September 30–October 9 freight holiday. An October 10 local report quotes the port in-charge and trader-group secretary confirming that import/export activity had resumed that morning. Passengers remained outside the freight stoppage.
record.consequences: No general economic effect is quantified by this research packet.
record.relationship: Separately reported local trader decision with a longer schedule than Sonamasjid/Hili and Benapole; no common authority or universal Bangladesh closure established.

A local October 10 report now confirms completed morning freight restart after September 30–October 9 interruption, supporting a linked ten-calendar-day operational phase. The advance eleven-day shorthand remains conflicting; passengers continued and Nepal/Bhutan remain onward trading partners.
